messages:
ellie_am: Quick heads-up 1 FellowsHealth (acct FH-778) hit a big ingestion spike during a scheduled data migration. They were charged for the overage on INV-2026-4123 and are asking for a one-time credit of $18,000 + a 30-day Dedicated trial extension while we investigate. Can finance sign off?

sanjay_sales: Got their support thread. Migration script on their side misfired; SRE acknowledged elevated token counts. They're strategic in healthcare, likely to convert. I support a customer credit to keep momentum.

maria_finance: Need facts: is invoice already posted? Billing period? Is this likely to recur? Also need GL code for any credit.

ellie_am: Invoice posted 2026-05-03. Billing period Apr 25	3May 2. SRE says root cause is customer migration config; customer remediated immediately. Looks one-off.

devon_revops: Note: they were on a trial Dedicated setup with temporary ingestion allowances; caps were enforced differently which caused unexpected overage. We can offer a one-off credit plus trial time. Any credit > $10k requires deal desk/finance approval.

maria_finance: For >$10k we need formal approval + GL instructions. Suggest reduce to $12k and treat remainder as CS goodwill unless exec approves. Need estimated ARR if we do full credit.
sanjay_sales: They're planning production Dedicated next quarter. Estimated ARR ~$120k. Full $18k credit will likely seal the deal. Recommend full credit.

maria_finance: Ok send a one-line business justification and retention probability for approval doc.
ellie_am: Justification: migration-induced spike inflated usage; credit requested to preserve relationship and avoid delaying conversion. Estimated ARR 110k-130k; retention probability high.
billing-bot: Credit memo CM-2026-078 created and queued. Approval status: pending finance approval.
maria_finance: I can provisionally approve contingent on legal sign-off for an amendment and explicit note that credit applies only to INV-2026-4123. Also need NetSuite comment and GL code.
devon_revops: I'll draft amendment language: 
```
Amendment: Redwood Inference will issue a one-time credit of $18,000 applied to invoice INV-2026-4123. Customer will receive a 30-day extension to their Dedicated trial. This is a single-instance customer satisfaction credit and does not modify pricing or constitute precedent.
```
sanjay_sales: LGTM, will forward to client once legal ok. :white_check_mark:

oliver_cfo: Jumping in 1 I approve the full $18k one-off credit. Executive exception warranted given expected ARR and strategic nature of the account. Please log as CFO-approved exception.

maria_finance: Confirmed CFO approval. I'll route CM-2026-078 for posting, use GL 7302 (Customer Credits  Exceptions), and add NetSuite memo referencing exec approval.
ellie_am: Thanks everyone. I'll notify FellowsHealth and apply the 30-day extension after credit posts. Devon please share final amendment with legal and cc billing.
devon_revops: Will do. Draft sent for legal review and I'll attach to the credit memo. Marking action items: billing to post CM-2026-078, legal to sign amendment, AM to notify customer.
ellie_am: Resolving thread once credit posts. Appreciate the quick turnaround! :raised_hands:
